editorial.blurb: A charming Caribbean-American breakfast and brunch spot where every plate—from the Caribella Skillet to the guava-kissed French toast—sings with warmth and flavor.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Yuca Fries with garlic as your appetizer while your main course cooks; pair it with a Coquito Latte (ask for toasted coconut on the whipped cream) for the full Caribella experience.
